meta.title: 分享一些大家买衣服最容易误解的高品质
meta.title_en: Quality Myths People Misread in Clothing

scenes.context: 后开衩上面这一块堆叠的量不是没做好，是故意留的活动量，方便穿脱和抬手臂。
sentences: 是穿脱抬手臂的活动量。
It's ease for dressing and raising your arms.
paraphrase: It's ease for dressing and raising your arms.
scenes.speak: That fold is deliberately added. It's ease for dressing and raising your arms.

scenes.context: 裤子上白色一小长条不是残品，这是牛角扣的纹理，真正的牛角扣找不到完全一样的两粒。
sentences: 真正的牛角扣纹理都不同。
Real horn buttons each have a unique grain.
paraphrase: Real horn buttons each have a unique grain.
scenes.speak: It's not a defective item. Real horn buttons each have a unique grain.

scenes.context: 亚麻衣服上的小结是麻结，相当于天然纤维亚麻的身份证，因为亚麻纤维短粗，纺纱难以完全均匀。
sentences: 纤维短粗难以完全均匀。
Short coarse fibers can't spin evenly.
paraphrase: Short coarse fibers can't spin evenly.
scenes.speak: Slubs are linen's identity card. Short coarse fibers can't spin evenly.

scenes.context: 麻结千万千万不要剪，剪了容易导致纤维断裂破洞。
sentences: 剪了容易纤维断裂破洞。
Cutting them causes breaks and holes.
paraphrase: Cutting them causes breaks and holes.
scenes.speak: Never cut the slubs off. Cutting them causes breaks and holes.

scenes.context: 格子衣服必须对齐，但合体的省道处不对齐才是合理正常的，因为剪开缝进去就会歪斜。
sentences: 省道处不对齐反而正常。
Misalignment at darts is actually correct.
paraphrase: Misalignment at darts is actually correct.
scenes.speak: Plaid must be matched. Misalignment at darts is actually correct.

scenes.context: 男装合体的格子衣服也是一样，所有正肩的衣服要看里布的结构。
sentences: The same applies to tailored men's plaid.
Pay attention to the inner structure.
paraphrase: The same applies to tailored men's plaid.
Pay attention to the inner structure.
scenes.speak: The same applies to tailored men's plaid. Pay attention to the inner structure.

scenes.context: 后中这一块有隐藏放量，包括下摆也是必须有的，这不是里布没烫好。
sentences: The center back has hidden ease.
paraphrase: The center back has hidden ease.
scenes.speak: The center back has hidden ease. It's a necessary construction.

scenes.context: 如果没有这个放量，伸胳膊抬手臂都会受到阻碍。
sentences: 伸胳膊抬手臂都要顺畅。
You need full range when reaching and lifting.
paraphrase: 用range of motion换一种说法
You need full range when reaching and lifting.
scenes.speak: Without ease, movement is restricted. You need full range when reaching and lifting.

practice: 后开衩的堆叠是故意留的放量。
That fold is deliberately added ease.
真正的牛角扣纹理都不同。
Real horn buttons each have a unique grain.
省道处的格子不对齐是正常的。
Misalignment at darts is actually correct.
pitfalls: 看到堆叠量以为是瑕疵
合体省道处不对齐是正常的
里布有放量以为没烫好
后中隐藏放量是必须工艺
